items.q: What is healthcare web portal development?
items.a: Healthcare web portal development involves creating secure online platforms for hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers to manage appointments, patient records, billing, telemedicine services, prescriptions, and healthcare operations digitally. These portals improve patient engagement, streamline workflows, and enhance healthcare management efficiency.

items.q: What features are included in healthcare portal development services?
items.a: Healthcare portal development services include patient portal development, hospital management systems, online appointment booking, telemedicine integration, electronic medical records, billing systems, doctor dashboards, pharmacy management, lab report management, notifications, and healthcare mobile app integration based on business requirements.

items.q: How much time does healthcare portal development take?
items.a: The development timeline depends on the complexity and features of the healthcare portal. A basic clinic management portal may take 6–8 weeks, while a complete hospital management system with telemedicine and advanced integrations can take 12–16 weeks.
